$comment: YiHot opportunity discovery *review queue* only. Never send this file to seed/import-approved-sources, and never infer source authorization from the listed URL.
scope: Child protection, grant/procurement opportunities, professional events, partnerships and evidence monitoring for YiHot.

already_registered.rss-gov-cn: China government policy RSS already staged/enabled in seed
already_registered.web-unicef-innocenti-reports: UNICEF research source already registered (seed disabled, runtime may differ)
already_registered.rss-un-news: UN Chinese news RSS exists (seed lacks explicit enabled=true, runtime may differ)
already_registered.rss-who-news: WHO news RSS exists; verify freshness rather than duplicate

candidates.name: 中国儿童中心·通知公告
needs: official listing preview in YiHot
verify title/date/link selectors and source permission
route professional events separately from children's own course advertisements
candidates.notes: Official event notices have publication dates; not every course enrollment is relevant to NGO staff.

candidates.name: 中国发展简报·公益资助招标会议活动培训
needs: verify exact current opportunities subpage URLs
confirm robots/terms and distinguish reposts from original issuer
parse deadline and eligibility from original announcement
candidates.notes: Opportunity index/link paths must be verified before adding a web_list source.

candidates.name: 中国政府采购网·地方招标公告
needs: verify openly available page pagination and permitted access
do not automate CAPTCHA-protected intent search
separate procurement, grants, suppliers, and award notices
extract province, budget, procuring body, deadline and applicant eligibility
candidates.notes: No API or RSS assumed; intentional CAPTCHA routes must remain manual.

candidates.name: United Nations Partner Portal·Partnership Opportunities
needs: confirm public opportunities view and terms
do not automate login or download gated PDFs
verify country/agency/sectors/deadline/CSO eligibility
notify only for eligible partner organizations
candidates.notes: Public listing is not an open grant for any given NGO; submitting requires registration.

candidates.name: PubMed·儿童干预研究检索订阅
needs: create official per-query RSS using PubMed Create RSS
record generated URL plus canonical query and original language
review article abstracts and access rights, never assume fulltext authorization
suggested_queries: (child protection OR violence against children) AND (intervention OR systematic review)
(parenting OR caregiver support) AND (child mental health) AND (meta-analysis OR randomized)
(inclusive early childhood education) AND (systematic review OR evaluation)
candidates.notes: No synthetic PubMed RSS link is invented.

candidates.name: ReliefWeb·Training & Reports
needs: request ReliefWeb approved appname
verify permitted API use and attribution
separate /v2/training from /v2/reports; date/registration/deadline as separate fields
filter by child protection/relevant regions
candidates.notes: Without approved appname do not insert a fake API URL into live sources.

candidates.name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal·Calls for Proposals
needs: verify RSS or native subscription feed with real account/query
screen geography and legal-entity eligibility before recommendation
keep tender and grant opportunity types separate
candidates.notes: Portal supports discovery; no arbitrary feed URL created.

candidates.name: Google Alerts·专项站点关键词补漏
needs: create alert manually with intended search, deliver to controlled RSS/email if available
avoid duplicate domain search results
confirm output, freshness and privacy terms
candidates.notes: Not first-party evidence and not a substitute for official notice.

review_sequence: date, deadline and eligibility extraction trial
